notes:
CRM notes:
- Account: mid-market SaaS (product analytics) building an in-app assistant + search/ranking pipelines. CTO (Dana Morales) emphasized: 'interactive chat must feel realtime — p50 <150ms, p95 <400ms for 16 token replies'.
- Flow so far: started on Hosted API (embedded chat + embeddings). Team ran dev latency checks and liked API ergonomics. Next step: Dedicated POC to hit production SLOs and get committed cost predictability.
- POC ask (scoped): 4-week Dedicated POC in us-west + eu-west regions. Objectives: validate p50/p95 SLOs under realistic traffic, exercise canary rollout, validate automated fallback routing to cheaper model variant and region failover, prove KV/prefix cache hits and batching savings.
- Canary + fallback plan (requested):
  * Canary: route 5% user traffic to Dedicated cluster (canary) for 72 hours; compare latency, token-cost metrics; staged ramp to 30% then 100% if metrics stable.
  * Fallback routing: primary -> high-quality model (quantized Llama 2 13B), fallback model variant -> optimized/quantized 6B variant for cost pressure; region fallback eu-west -> us-west on region outage.
  * Automated rollback: threshold-based (p95 latency increase >30% or error rate >1.5%) triggers instant rollback to hosted fallback or prior model version. Need runbook + automated alerting hooks (PagerDuty).
- Acceptance criteria for POC: sustained p50 <150ms, p95 <400ms at 60 qps steady; model output quality within 5% of hosted baseline (unit tests/QA eval set); end-to-end failover tested without >1 min downtime.
- Security/compliance: require SSO/SAML integration, KMS for keys, retention controls and audit logs, EU data residency for a subset of customer data. SOC2 must be on roadmap; procurement prefers vendor SOC2 now.
- Cost sensitivity: moderate. Want predictable committed monthly charge; open to 12-month reserved capacity if POC meets SLOs.
- Quotes from stakeholders: CTO: 'We need deterministic tail latency and a graceful cost fallback — can't have surprise monthly bills.' Product lead: 'Model hallucination tolerance very low for recommendations — reranker must be stable.'
- Internal redlines: cannot ship PII outside EU region for EU customers; legal wants a clause around data deletion on contract end.
- Logistics: network egress/IP allowlist required for Dedicated; SE asked for temporary firewall rules and a test certificate.
- Documents shared: pricing deck (drive link), security FAQ response (drive link), initial SOW template (drive link).
- Next steps (short): schedule POC kickoff, finalize capacity commit and pricing, confirm SOC2 evidence or compensating controls, SE to produce canary playbook and failure scenarios.
